_doc: Blocs communs à tous les prompts. Les prompts complets sont assemblés par `pnpm art:generer` (tools/asset-pipeline/src/gen/prompts.ts) ; `pnpm art:generer --liste` les affiche sans rien envoyer.
style: Style: classic hand-drawn 2D feature animation, 1990s cel look. Simple, appealing shapes and a strong readable silhouette. Clean uniform ink outline in dark brown-black (#2B1B17), never pure black. Few interior lines, no muscle definition lines, no fabric wrinkles beyond one or two folds, no small ornaments. Flat color fills with ONE darker shadow tone, light coming from the top left, no gradients, no texture, no painterly rendering, no glow.
fond: Plain solid pure white background (#FFFFFF), no checkerboard, no ground shadow, no ground line, no text, no labels, no frame, no cell borders.
couleurs: Colors must match the in-game pixel-art sprites exactly. Skin: warm copper brown ({peau}, shadow {peauOmbre}) for every soldier. Hair: very dark brown ({cheveux}), short and curly. Team color: {equipeNom} ({equipe2}, shadow {equipe1}, light {equipe3}), used ONLY on the team parts named in the design. Metal: gold ({or}, light {orClair}). Cloth: cream ({creme}). Wood: warm brown ({bois}).
couleursPures: No other red, crimson, pink or orange-red anywhere in the image (mouths and lips in dark brown), so the team color can be swapped automatically.
referenceSprite: The attached image is the in-game pixel-art sprite sheet of this unit (in its red team color). Use it as the exact reference for the design: same equipment, same headwear, same shield and weapon, same skin tone, same colors and where each color goes. Redraw it as a large hand-drawn animation character with natural proportions (not chibi, not pixel art).
referencePoses: Use the attached pose sheet as the exact reference for this character: same face, same equipment, same colors, same proportions and SAME SIZE as the first (idle) drawing.
cadrePoses: Create a 2D animation pose sheet: 4 full-body drawings of the SAME character side by side in one horizontal row, 4 equal invisible columns, same size in every drawing, feet resting on the same baseline, generous empty space around each figure, nothing touching the image edges or the neighbouring figure. All drawings face RIGHT, in a 3/4 side view.
cadreSequence: Create 4 frames of a hand-drawn animation sequence, side by side in one wide image, 4 equal invisible columns, as if filmed by a locked camera: the character stays at the same place in each column, on the same ground baseline, facing RIGHT in a 3/4 side view, same size in every frame. Nothing touches the image edges or the neighbouring frame.
sonne: The character is knocked out in a comical, non-violent way, like in a family animated film: no blood, no injury. Frames 3 and 4 must be almost identical except for the sway, so they can loop. Do not draw any stars, birds or symbols above the head.
